home.summary: This archive captures 94 escape room adventures across seven countries and 16 regions, with a wealth of shared experiences and insights from the community over 11 years.

featured.summary: Explore two standout trips—Escape in Europe and QMSB—along with notable awards like Best Things and Best Things Twin Cities, featuring contributions from Jamie, Mazie, Tammy, and Tyler.

jamie.intro: Jamie navigates rooms with a systems mindset, leading the group with a keen sense for puzzle structure and flow.

mazie.intro: Mazie energizes the team with her intuition and keen pattern recognition, often discovering the connections that unlock progress.

tammy.intro: Tammy keeps the team coordinated and focused, skillfully tracking clues and ensuring efficient collaboration.

tyler.intro: Tyler brings a detail-oriented and methodical approach to puzzles, making steady progress with disciplined execution.

best-things.intro: This award represents our take on the standout rooms that have captured our hearts.

best-things-twin-cities.intro: Recognizing the top experiences in the Twin Cities, based on our collective adventures.

escape-in-europe.intro: A memorable journey from the Netherlands to Spain, exploring rich themes and puzzles across cities like Amsterdam and Barcelona.
escape-in-europe.routeSummary: Starting in Voorburg, the route winds through Utrecht and Brussels, before making stops in Paris and Barcelona.

qmsb.intro: An exciting Canadian lineup that spans Laval and Quebec City, featuring rooms rich in narrative and challenge.
qmsb.routeSummary: Beginning in Quebec City, the run progresses to Laval, culminating in a variety of distinct gaming experiences.

1-jamie-s-escape-in-europe-favorites.intro: A personal selection of favorite rooms from Jamie's European travels, showcasing the standout experiences encountered along the adventure.
